bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-mp4-document-4d24)" || exit 62
code="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT d.data->>'shareCode' FROM public_post_drafts d JOIN link_button_posts p ON p.owner_user_id=d.owner_user_id AND p.share_code=d.data->>'shareCode' WHERE d.module='link' AND d.data::text LIKE '%動画付きのリンク%' AND p.media_kind='document' AND p.revision=1 AND p.media_file_id IS NOT NULL;")" || exit 63
test "${#code}" -eq 24 || exit 64
cd "$root"
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 4d24f7efa0a1d7671d96408842d8cd24d12de8b4 || exit 66
test "$(git hash-object scripts/userbot_link_saved_message_smoke.py)" = "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_link_saved_message_smoke.py)" || exit 67
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-link-native-doc-e2e.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_test_client.py > "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" || exit 68
PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 69
if PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" link_send_saved_smoke --code "$code" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
 PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 71
 echo MP4_DOCUMENT_SHARED_RICH_AND_SAME_CODE_EDIT=PASS
else
 test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 72
 PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 73
 exit 80
fi
